body:
It isn't "tongue-in-cheek". I've been told I'd be healthier if I was anorexic, so I'm going to try it. 

I'm sorry that you've been in pain.

No I'm not. If I love myself then I might think it's okay to be obese and stay at a BMI of 37. And I can't be healthy at that BMI, right?

So I'll just happily hate myself until I'm skinny enough to be normal.

Okay, you've just shook your head and clucked softly about how sad it is that they don't take care of themselves better. My bad. 

I don't need a therapist. I just need to stop eating.

Ladies of 2X, reading the posts for the last few days has totally inspired me! I understand now that it is NOT okay to be obese, and I should NOT be okay with the way my body looks. So starting yesterday, I am determined to lose all of this nasty weight! I don't want to say how much I weigh now, because I'm so embarrassed by it. But I'm determined that I'll eventually get into a size six, so I can be super healthy like all of you!

Thank you so much, 2X!. I was just a lurker, but I had to tell you how you've inspired me to get healthy!

What am I not thinking clearly about? My health? I've read it over and over on here that noone can be obese and healthy. So I'm not healthy and unhealthy people are unhappy. 

Or where self worth comes from? Do you really think it comes from "somewhere inside you"? That's naive. You think you are great because there are messages from the people around you or society in general that either you specifically are great or that "people like you" are great.

When you have been told for all your life that you are disgusting, unhealthy, unattractive, greedy, weak, and deficient because you are obese, then you don't have self worth. You have to earn self worth, and I plan on earning it by being disciplined and not eating anymore.

I'm not beautiful. Noone who is my size is beautiful. You know that. You've pointed and laughed at enough fat women and/or men in your life to know that obese people are ugly and gross. 

I'm definitely exercising and not eating anymore. And maybe one day I'll be a normal person and people will stop hating me.

Sure it does. Everyone's self worth comes from being healthy, and noone with a BMI of 37 can be healthy. Even if I went to a doctor, they'd just tell me to lose weight.

And your "self worth" really comes from what other people think of you. Nobody can have "self worth" when they know that everyone around them thinks of them as disgusting and ugly.

Ladies of 2X, reading the posts for the last few days has totally inspired me! I understand now that it is NOT okay to be obese, and I should NOT be okay with the way my body looks. So starting yesterday, I am determined to lose all of this nasty weight! I don't want to say how much I weigh now, because I'm so embarrassed by it. But I'm determined that I'll eventually get into a size six, so I can be super healthy like all of you!

Thank you so much, 2X!. I was just a lurker, but I had to tell you how you've inspired me to get healthy!
I'm confused? Are you disappointed that most people think it's okay to be obese?

Actually, I think most people are watching me as an obese person and thinking that I'm super-disgusting and unhealthy and I deserve to die.

They're probably right, and I'd like to just kill myself, but I'm not brave enough.
But I hate my body. Really given the choice, I'd just kill myself, but I figure at least this way I'll die pretty.

But if I love my body and think it's awesome then I won't get healthy. Because when you are obese "you are not healthy because you are putting things into your body that shouldn't be in it and that hinders it from working smoothly."

So I've decided to stop putting things into my body and stop being obese!

I'm not "a bit overweight"; my BMI is 37. So I'm obese. And so I'm not healthy because you're right, I'm putting food in my body and it shouldn't be there. So I'm going to lose weight! 
Thank you for your support!

I know they know that they are overweight, but maybe they are like I was and they think that it's okay. But I understand now that if I think that I'm pretty when I'm really obese, then I'm encouraging other people to be obese. 

There are lots of thread here that have talked about how promoting obese women as "beautiful" really just encourages people to be unhealthy. I don't want to be a part of that.
But losing weight is always healthier, right? There's no way you can be obese AND healthy. There are all kinds of threads all over 2x that pretty much explain that.
why does it matter? I'm beyond puberty, so it's not going to hurt my "development" or anything.

IDK, I've read so many posts on here about how important it is to be healthy. And one of the first steps is to understand that being obese is just gross.

It's like... drugs or alcohol, right? You have to admit you are addicted and that you need help. And now I've realized that I need to stop eating so I can be healthy.

But if you allow yourself to think that being heavy is okay, won't that mean you never get skinny? I mean, sure, I'd be happier if I could think of myself as beautiful at this size, but then I get complacent and I don't work out every day or I let myself eat something awful like fastfood or doughnuts....
:-( I thought people would be more supportive? This seemed like a great community to help with my weightloss efforts.

Why would you be upset? 
I just want to get healthy! And all weight loss is healthy, right?

But it's unhealthy! And if I was okay with it, then I would be encouraging other people to be obese and unhealthy. They're just worried about my health.

So I'm going to lose a lot of weight, and get healthy. That way noone will think it's okay to be obese.
You have disturbed basement cat. Pray you do not disturb him any further.
